patterns_discovered.description: Tests cover model creation, field validation, properties, relationships, and business logic workflows
Both test cases use setUp() to create common test fixtures including users, warehouse, materials, and suppliers
Uses Decimal type for all monetary and quantitative values (quantity, prices, density)
Tests both positive and negative validation scenarios using assertRaises(ValidationError)
Tests foreign key relationships and optional relationships (preferred_supplier can be None)
Tests status transitions (DRAFT -> PENDING -> APPROVED) and related behaviors
Tests computed properties like total_value, total_price, can_approve, can_edit
properties: total_value - sum of all item totals

gotchas_discovered.issue: str() methods have specific format requirements (e.g., 'SC00001 - Aguardando Aprovacao')
gotchas_discovered.implication: Changes to __str__ method format will break tests, making this a useful regression detection point

gotchas_discovered.issue: reference_number must be unique; manual attempts to create duplicates should fail
gotchas_discovered.implication: Database integrity enforcement is tested, not just model validation

gotchas_discovered.issue: total_price returns Decimal('0') when estimated_unit_price is None, not None itself
gotchas_discovered.implication: Edge case handling for null values should default to 0, not null

gotchas_discovered.issue: Quantity validation (must be > 0) is enforced through full_clean() not save()
gotchas_discovered.implication: Tests use full_clean() rather than save() for validation testing

gotchas_discovered.issue: can_approve and can_edit properties depend on status values; APPROVED and REJECTED prevent editing
gotchas_discovered.implication: Status field is critical control point for workflow state machine

gotchas_discovered.issue: approved_by and approved_at fields should be populated together during approval workflow
gotchas_discovered.implication: Approval is a compound operation requiring multiple fields to be set consistently

gotchas_discovered.issue: required_date expects future dates; tests use timezone.now() + timedelta(days=30)
gotchas_discovered.implication: Date validation may enforce future-date requirement not explicitly tested here

approach_outcome.test_coverage_assessment: Comprehensive - 22 test methods covering creation, validation, properties, relationships, and workflows
approach_outcome.methodology: Test-driven approach with arrange-act-assert pattern throughout
approach_outcome.test_execution_success: All tests passed on first attempt
key_achievements: Created complete test suite for both PurchaseRequest and PurchaseRequestItem models
Covered all major model behaviors and business logic
Implemented proper setup with realistic test data
Tested edge cases and validation scenarios
Verified relationship integrity and workflow state management
